description: National Physical Planning Department - The Town and Country Planning (General Interim Development) Order - 2024
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes an Interim Development Order under the Town and Country Planning Ordinance, creating regulatory frameworks for land development in the Eastern Province. It outlines legal procedures, permit requirements, development controls, and enforcement mechanisms. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to create regulations, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The content primarily focuses on establishing legal/regulatory frameworks for urban planning and development control.
